projects.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration Platform: Designed autonomous agent ecosystem using LangGraph for complex workflow automation. Implemented ReAct patterns for iterative reasoning and tool usage. Achieved high marginal reduction in manual process time through intelligent agent collaboration.

Agentic RAG System: Built enterprise knowledge management solution with autonomous agents for document retrieval, analysis, and synthesis. Integrated with LangChain for dynamic tool selection and context-aware responses. Deployed privacy-aware architecture handling sensitive corporate data.

Intelligent Process Automation: Developed multi-agent system for end-to-end business process automation using CrewAI. Implemented specialized agents for data extraction, validation, and decision-making. Reduced processing time while improving accuracy.

AI Workflow Orchestration: Created scalable orchestration framework using ADK Orchestrate for coordinating multiple AI models. Implemented explainable decision paths and real-time monitoring. Successfully deployed in production serving 10K+ daily requests.

Enterprise RAG Implementation: Designed and deployed production RAG system using advanced embedding strategies and hybrid search. Achieved high accuracy in document retrieval with sub-second response times.

Custom LLM Fine-tuning: Fine-tuned domain-specific language models for diverse domains including healthcare and financial services. Implemented LoRA and QLoRA techniques for efficient adaptation. Gained improvement in domain-specific task performance.
Conversational AI Platform: Built intelligent chatbot system using GPT family models with custom prompt engineering and context management. Integrated with business systems via FastAPI microservices.

Document Intelligence System: Developed end-to-end document analysis pipeline combining OCR, layout analysis, and semantic extraction. Published research in IEEE TPAMI on hierarchical attention networks. Achieved state-of-the-art results on benchmark datasets.
Vision-Language Models: Implemented multimodal systems integrating text and image processing for content understanding. Utilized transformer architectures (CLIP, BLIP) for cross-modal retrieval.

AI-Powered Video Analytics: Created real-time video analysis system combining object detection, tracking, and activity recognition. Optimized for edge deployment using TensorRT and ONNX. Processing 30 FPS on standard hardware.
